method.pose: 32 compressed target-skeleton samples before root lock; global bone transform already includes root transform
method.contact: Both foot and ball endpoints within 3 cm of respective sampled minimum Z, full 3D speeds <=40 cm/s, >=3 consecutive intervals. Loop runs merge across time zero. Initial nonloop support is recorded separately.
method.sensitivity: Repeat candidate identification at 2 cm/30 cm/s and 4 cm/50 cm/s; require one sustained interval per side for each loop. Report onset shifts, do not hide them.
method.speed: Net horizontal root displacement / clip duration. Per-loop play rate 157/natural speed is a tuning suggestion, not written to the asset. Root-path average reported as a cross-check.

entry_contract: All eight authored Stops begin with right support. There are no opposite-foot Stop variants in these 35 assets; an arbitrary-time seamless Stop is not established.
Start_F_R90 begins with left support; several other Starts include both or right support. Preserve the authored zero-time entry and match the outgoing contact at loop handoff.
Do not defer block cancellation, death, hit or movement-cap cleanup for an animation contact window. Missing contact match needs an interruptible blend/fallback.
Markers identify stable support starts; this is a convention for phase matching, not exact heel-strike.
limitations: These are pose-derived candidates, not collision/contact or visual acceptance.
Nominal quantization is one sample interval: ~34.4 ms loop, ~20.4 ms start, ~33.9 ms stop, ~48.4 ms turn. Threshold/retarget/model uncertainty is additional.
B_L45 right-loop support begins at 0.860215 s nominally but 0.997849 s under the strict threshold; review this contact before final tuning.
Natural-speed scaling does not prove foot locking. Start/stop rates are authored at 1; stop entry follows the selected contact phase; do not divide by their lower full-clip average speed.
Turn and start/stop marker candidates can include settling or a pivot without a new touchdown; inspect transitions visually.
Idle/block-hit/parry sequences receive no invented sync markers.
